- **Production** gets it with the next cloud release. None has been cut since.

The merge gate on this card is met. Nothing else is owed from this lane.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: nothing moves — RIGHT.** The `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` hunk is confined to the `App.defaultAgent` TSDoc block (`:1655`–`:1669`). `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema.optional()` and its `.describe()` text are byte-identical to the merge-base. No generated reference moves: `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx:80` and `references/api/metadata.mdx:106` repeat only the unchanged `.describe()` text.
- **Docs callout — RIGHT.** `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx:273`–`:276` drops `/api/v1/ai/assistant/chat` and keeps the agent route with its pre-existing account of `req.user` and `toolExecutionContext`. The sentence narrows; it adds no claim.

The docblock describes `defaultAgent` as read by the console's agent surfaces, naming `surfaceAgent.ts` and `ChatDock.tsx`, and never claims a server route reads it — the claim's ⛔ holds. The ADR-0063 §1/§2 surface-binding paragraph, the resolvable-value rule and the `@example` are byte-identical on the head.
- **Accuracy against objectui at `0abd4f9f87`, sentence by sentence:**
  - "The chat dock hands the active app's `defaultAgent` to the console's one surface→agent resolver (`surfaceAgent.ts`, called from `ChatDock.tsx`)" — BORNE OUT. `ConsoleLayout.tsx:176` (rail) and `:234` (mobile sheet) pass `activeApp?.defaultAgent`; `ChatDock.tsx:296`–`:304` calls `resolveSurfaceAgent('default', { agents, appDefaultAgent: defaultAgent, aiStudioEnabled, canAuthorMetadata })`.
  - "honours it only when it names `ask` or `build` (legacy aliases included)" — BORNE OUT. `surfaceAgent.ts:128` keeps the value only under `isBuiltinAgentName`, whose groups (`plugin-chatbot/src/agentAliases.ts:23`–`:26`) are exactly `build`/`metadata_assistant` and `ask`/`data_chat`; nothing else passes.
  - "otherwise falls back to the surface default" — BORNE OUT. `surfaceAgent.ts:130`, `SURFACE_DEFAULT.default` is `ask`.
  - "The agent it resolves is then called by name on the agent route" — BORNE OUT. `ChatDock.tsx:307`–`:309` builds `apiBase/agents/NAME/chat`, `resolveApiBase()` defaults to `/api/v1/ai` (`AiChatPage.tsx:133`, `:458`–`:465`), and `ChatPane` hands that URL to the chat transport as `api: chatApi` (`AiChatPage.tsx:1739`).

The docblock states the bound as a necessary condition and says "the agent it resolves", so it does not contradict this; the PR body spells out all five steps.

The kept sentence on the bare `POST /api/v1/ai/chat` route is the pre-existing claim shortened, not a new one; the card is silent on that route and so is this review.
